assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: actual production diffuse/albedo texture for a cylindrical blue-and-white porcelain brush pot in a high-quality real-time 3D Chinese movable-type printing workshop. Generate a single square 2048x2048 flat unwrapped ceramic surface texture, not a rendered pot and not a scene. Warm ivory unglazed-white ground with understated hand-painted cobalt blue bamboo branches and fine clusters of slender bamboo leaves, a few elegant restrained cloud curls near the base. Thin double cobalt border lines near top and bottom, keeping 8% clean warm ivory margins at the image's upper and lower edges. Painting feels like authentic refined old Chinese blue-and-white pottery, nuanced blue brush load and very fine natural ink-edge variation, lightly worn pigment only, no heavy dirt or cracks. Motifs spaced asymmetrically with ample clean porcelain between, modest contrast and very fine hand-painted details. Horizontally seamless repeat for UV wrapping around a cylindrical brush pot, left and right edges match; vertical wrapping not required. True flat orthographic albedo: completely even diffuse illumination, absolutely no object contour, perspective, cylinder silhouette, cast shadow, light gradient, highlights, baked ambient occlusion or glossy reflections. No text, calligraphy, symbols, frames, logos, watermark, people, photo backdrop, brush tools. Full canvas is only the surface color pattern. Premium quiet craftsmanship, not a busy ornate wallpaper.
